cell_id1 <- "CX1"
cell_id2 <- "CX2"

cell_id1Treated <- TRUE
cell_id2Treated <- FALSE

cell_id1Before <- 5415
cell_id2Before <- 8123

cell_id1After <- 1423
cell_idAfter <- 7543

cell_id <- c(cell_id1, cell_id2)
Treated <- c(cell_id1Treated, cell_id2Treated)
Before <- c(cell_id1Before, cell_id2Before)
After <- c(cell_id1After, cell_idAfter)

```{r}

library(tidyverse)
library(gt)

RadiationData <- tibble(
  cell_ID = cell_id,
  treated = Treated,
  num_cells_before = Before,
  num_cells_after = After
)

gt(RadiationData)
```

```{r}
cell_id1 <- "CX1"
cell_id2 <- "CX2"

cell_id1Treated <- TRUE
cell_id2Treated <- FALSE

cell_id1Before <- 5415
cell_id2Before <- 8123

cell_id1After <- 1423
cell_idAfter <- 7543

cell_id <- c(cell_id1, cell_id2)
Treated <- c(cell_id1Treated, cell_id2Treated)
Before <- c(cell_id1Before, cell_id2Before)
After <- c(cell_id1After, cell_idAfter)
```
```{r}
RadiationData <- tibble(
  cell_ID = cell_id,
  treated = Treated,
  num_cells_before = Before,
  num_cells_after = After
)

gt(RadiationData)
```
